sources.title: GitHub - shanmati-suresh/mistral-summary: AI driven Summarization model
sources.snippet: Mistral AI provides the Mistral-7B-Instruct-v0.3 model, an open-weight large language model fine-tuned to follow human instructions. In this script, Mistral AI's model is responsible for: Understanding natural language instructions. Processing the extracted PDF content. Generating a human-like summary that captures the core ideas of the document.
